themes: Craft as a gift from Allah
summary_for_children: Surah Saba tells of Dawud, for whom iron was made soft, and Sulayman, for whom a spring of copper flowed. Then it tells of the people of Saba who had two beautiful gardens but turned away, and lost them in a flood.
world_title: Gardens of Saba and the Copper Spring
environment_concept: Hills that echo with praise and birds (34:10), a glowing spring of copper (34:12), great basins (34:13), gardens on both sides of a dam (34:15) and a broken one where the trees fell (34:16).
architecture_and_scenery: Mountains echoing praise, a forge, a flowing copper spring, great bowls like reservoirs, and the fertile valley of Saba behind a dam.

palette.lighting: Warm forge light and green valley sun
palette.atmosphere: Echoes in the mountains, water over the dam

areas.name: Mountains of Praise
areas.description: Hills that echo as if repeating praise.

areas.name: Copper Spring
areas.description: A glowing spring of liquid copper.

areas.name: Great Bowls
areas.description: Bowls like reservoirs and fixed kettles.

areas.name: Gardens of Saba
areas.description: Gardens on either side of a valley.

areas.name: Flood of the Dam
areas.description: The dam breaking and gardens changing to bitter fruit.

activities.name: Work in gratitude
activities.description: Carry four jars to fill the great basins.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Before and after
activities.description: Compare the gardens before and after and talk about gratitude.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration keeps prophets unseen and draws the gratitude lesson from the ayahs.
learning_objectives: Name the gifts of Dawud and Sulayman

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (birds, bowls, copper, dam, fallen, mountain) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.tier: conceptual for the new engine (an older composed scene exists; not validated as unique)
